newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel diffs inch higher, outrights surge.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel diffs inch higher, outrights surge.

text.p: U.S. prompt jet fuel differentials firmed modestly by late Thursday, while outright prices jumped sharply tracking the NYMEX gains.
On the NYMEX, August heating oil futures rallied 1.21 cents to settle at 53.89 cents a gallon.
U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel traded at 0.20 cent over the August NYMEX, up about 0.20 cent from Wednesday's levels.
Prompt low sulphur 55-grade jet fuel sat at a 0.15 cent premium to the 54-grade, according to traders.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel changed hands at 2.25 cents over the August futures, the high end of the range created Wednesday.
